    async function transformJsonResponse(response, toolName, run, trailingPrefillText = '') {
        // Bound the complete-response path as well as individual streaming records.
        const reader = response.body.getReader();
        const decoder = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true });
        let text = '', bytes = 0, eof = false;
        try {
            while (true) {
                const next = await reader.read();
                if (next.done) { eof = true; text += decoder.decode(); break; }
                bytes += next.value.byteLength; run.bytes(next.value.byteLength);
                if (bytes > STREAM_LIMIT) throw streamError('completion_too_large');
                text += decoder.decode(next.value, { stream: true });
            }
        } finally { if (!eof) await reader.cancel().catch(() => {}); reader.releaseLock(); }
        let parsed;
        try { parsed = JSON.parse(text); } catch { throw streamError('invalid_completion_json'); }
        if (parsed?.error || parsed?.type === 'error') {
            return {
                response: new Response(text, { status: response.status, statusText: response.statusText, headers: responseHeaders(response) }),
                stats: { endedCleanly: false, streamed: false, ...failureDetails(providerError(parsed, 'upstream_error')) },
            };
        }
        const result = normalizeOpenAiResponse(parsed, toolName, trailingPrefillText);
        if (result.chars) run.content(result.chars);
        return {
            response: new Response(JSON.stringify(result.parsed), {
                status: response.status, statusText: response.statusText,
                headers: responseHeaders(response, 'application/json; charset=utf-8'),
            }),
            stats: { syntheticHit: result.hit, recoveredChars: result.chars, contentConflict: result.conflict,
                endedCleanly: result.integrity, semanticChecked: true, connectionCompleted: true,
                finishReasons: result.finishReasons, streamed: false, progressive: false },
        };
    }

    function createRun(prepared, args) {
        const id = ++runtime.runSerial;
        const started = Date.now();
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const inputSignal = args[1]?.signal ?? (args[0] instanceof Request ? args[0].signal : null);
        const stats = { id, time: started, phase: 'waiting-headers', ...prepared.summary,
            syntheticHit: false, recoveredChars: 0, contentConflict: false, endedCleanly: null,
            streamed: prepared.stream, headerMs: null, firstByteMs: null, firstContentMs: null,
            upstreamBytes: 0, upstreamRecords: 0, upstreamHeartbeats: 0, localHeartbeats: 0,

            const existingIdx = runtime.runHistory.findIndex(item => item && item.id === id);

                runtime.runHistory[existingIdx] = snap;
            } else {
                runtime.runHistory.unshift(snap);
                if (runtime.runHistory.length > 30) runtime.runHistory.length = 30;
            }

                runtime.lastRun = snap;
            }

            if (runtime.disposed) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            if (!force && now - lastPublish < 600) return;

            syncRunHistoryRecord();
            syncConfigPanel();
        };

            if (finished) return;

            stats.warning = gap >= STREAM_POLICY.idleWarningMs
                ? (stats.headerMs === null ? '响应头尚未到达' : '上游字节静默') + ' ' + Math.floor(gap / 1000) + ' 秒'
                : stats.outputMode === 'tool' && stats.idleContentMs >= STREAM_POLICY.idleWarningMs
                    ? (stats.firstContentMs === null ? '上游有数据，正文尚未到达' : '上游有数据，正文暂未增加') + ' ' + Math.floor(stats.idleContentMs / 1000) + ' 秒' : '';

            update(values) { if (!finished) { Object.assign(stats, values); publish(); } },
            headers(response) { stats.headerMs = Date.now() - started; stats.phase = 'waiting-body'; stats.httpStatus = response.status; publish(true); },
            bytes(size) {

                const now = Date.now(); stats.maxByteGapMs = Math.max(stats.maxByteGapMs, now - lastByte);
                lastByte = now; stats.lastByteMs = now - started; stats.firstByteMs ??= stats.lastByteMs;
                stats.upstreamBytes += size; stats.phase = 'streaming'; stats.warning = ''; publish();
            },
            record(record) { stats.upstreamRecords++; if (record.data === null) stats.upstreamHeartbeats++; },
            content(size) {

                        : stats.firstContentMs === null ? '已有响应字节但无正文；检查工具参数缓冲与渠道错误'

                    console.warn(`[${SCRIPT_NAME}] 生成请求中断`, {
                        version: VERSION, durationMs: stats.duration, httpStatus: stats.httpStatus,
                        headerMs: stats.headerMs, firstByteMs: stats.firstByteMs, firstContentMs: stats.firstContentMs,
                        upstreamBytes: stats.upstreamBytes, upstreamRecords: stats.upstreamRecords,

    function formatRunTelemetryTag(run) {
        if (!run) return '';
        const tierTag = run.requestTier === 'story' ? '正文' : '插件';
        const modeTag = run.outputMode === 'tool'
            ? (run.syntheticHit ? '工具流命中' : '工具流注入')
            : '普通流';
        const escMap = {
            json_escape: '整包转义',
            compact: '码点转义',
            hybrid_image: '转图片',
            full_armor: '深度破盾',
            off: '未转义',
        };
        const escTag = escMap[run.inputMode] || '未转义';
        const charsTag = typeof run.recoveredChars === 'number' && run.recoveredChars > 0 ? ` · ${run.recoveredChars}字` : '';
        return `${tierTag} · ${modeTag} · ${escTag}${charsTag}`;
    }

    function pickBestDisplayRun() {
        if (runtime.activeRuns.size > 0) {
            const activeList = Array.from(runtime.activeRuns.values()).map(r => r.stats);
            const activeStory = activeList.find(s => s && s.requestTier === 'story');
            return activeStory || activeList[activeList.length - 1];
        }
        const recentStory = runtime.runHistory.find(s => s && s.requestTier === 'story');
        return recentStory || runtime.runHistory[0] || runtime.lastRun || null;
    }

            status: firstResponse.status,
            statusText: firstResponse.statusText,
            headers: responseHeaders(firstResponse, 'text/event-stream; charset=utf-8'),
        });
    }

    async function handleResilientPlainJsonResponse(firstResponse, run = null) {
        const unmaskOn = runtime.settings.argonGuardEnabled !== false;
        let rawText = '';
        try {
            rawText = await firstResponse.clone().text();
        } catch (_) {
            return firstResponse;
        }
        if (!rawText || !rawText.trim()) return firstResponse;
        try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(rawText);
            if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
                if (parsed.error || parsed.promptFeedback?.blockReason) {
                    return firstResponse;
                }
                let recoveredChars = 0;
                const finishReasons = [];
                if (Array.isArray(parsed.choices)) {
                    for (const ch of parsed.choices) {
                        if (ch?.finish_reason && !finishReasons.includes(ch.finish_reason)) finishReasons.push(ch.finish_reason);
                        const msg = ch?.message;
                        if (msg && typeof msg === 'object') {
                            if (typeof msg.content === 'string') {
                                if (unmaskOn) msg.content = stripLeakedInjectedArtifacts(unmaskNSFWTokens(msg.content));
                                recoveredChars += msg.content.length;
                            }
                            if (typeof msg.reasoning_content === 'string' && unmaskOn) msg.reasoning_content = unmaskNSFWTokens(msg.reasoning_content);
                            if (typeof msg.reasoning === 'string' && unmaskOn) msg.reasoning = unmaskNSFWTokens(msg.reasoning);
                            if ((!msg.content || !String(msg.content).trim()) && (!Array.isArray(msg.tool_calls) || msg.tool_calls.length === 0)) {
                                const fallbackRsn = (typeof msg.reasoning_content === 'string' && msg.reasoning_content.trim())
                                    ? msg.reasoning_content
                                    : (typeof msg.reasoning === 'string' && msg.reasoning.trim() ? msg.reasoning : '');
                                if (fallbackRsn) {
                                    msg.content = unmaskOn ? stripLeakedInjectedArtifacts(fallbackRsn) : fallbackRsn;
                                    recoveredChars += msg.content.length;
                                }
                            }
                            if (Array.isArray(msg.tool_calls) && msg.tool_calls.length > 0) {
                                for (const tc of msg.tool_calls) {
                                    if (tc?.function && typeof tc.function.arguments === 'string') {
                                        try {
                                            const argObj = JSON.parse(tc.function.arguments);
                                            if (typeof argObj?.content === 'string') {
                                                if (unmaskOn) argObj.content = stripLeakedInjectedArtifacts(unmaskNSFWTokens(argObj.content));
                                                recoveredChars += argObj.content.length;
                                                if (unmaskOn) tc.function.arguments = JSON.stringify(argObj);
                                            }
                                        } catch (_) {}
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else if (Array.isArray(parsed.candidates)) {
                    for (const cand of parsed.candidates) {
                        if (cand?.finishReason && !finishReasons.includes(cand.finishReason)) finishReasons.push(cand.finishReason);
                        const parts = cand?.content?.parts;
                        if (Array.isArray(parts)) {
                            for (const pt of parts) {
                                if (pt && typeof pt.text === 'string') {
                                    if (unmaskOn) pt.text = unmaskNSFWTokens(pt.text);
                                    if (pt.thought !== true) recoveredChars += pt.text.length;
                                }
                                if (pt?.functionCall?.args && typeof pt.functionCall.args.content === 'string') {
                                    if (unmaskOn) pt.functionCall.args.content = stripLeakedInjectedArtifacts(unmaskNSFWTokens(pt.functionCall.args.content));
                                    recoveredChars += pt.functionCall.args.content.length;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                try {
                    if (run) {
                        run.record({ data: parsed });
                        if (recoveredChars > 0) run.content(recoveredChars);
                        if (finishReasons.length > 0) run.update({ finishReasons });
                    }
                } catch (_) {}
                if (!unmaskOn) return firstResponse;
                return copyResponse(firstResponse, JSON.stringify(parsed), 'application/json; charset=utf-8');
            }
        } catch (_) {
            if (!unmaskOn) return firstResponse;
            return copyResponse(firstResponse, unmaskNSFWTokens(rawText), 'application/json; charset=utf-8');
        }
        return firstResponse;
    }

    async function handleGeneration(original, thisArg, args) {
        const targetUrl = resolveUrl(args[0]);
        if (!interceptionEnabled()) {
            if (isSameOriginApiPath(targetUrl)) {
                const nextArgs = applySameOriginCsrfHeaders(targetUrl, args);
                return executeWithCsrfRetry(original, thisArg, nextArgs, targetUrl, null, nextArgs[1]?.signal || (isRequestLike(nextArgs[0]) ? nextArgs[0].signal : null));
            }
            return original.apply(thisArg, args);
        }
        const raw = await requestText(args);
        if (raw === null) {
            const nextArgs = applySameOriginCsrfHeaders(targetUrl, args);
            return executeWithCsrfRetry(original, thisArg, nextArgs, targetUrl, null, nextArgs[1]?.signal || (isRequestLike(nextArgs[0]) ? nextArgs[0].signal : null));
        }
        const prepared = prepareRequest(raw, targetUrl);
        if (prepared.kind === 'passthrough-clean') {
            const nextArgs = prepared.changed ? withBody(args, prepared.body) : applySameOriginCsrfHeaders(targetUrl, args);
            const replayBody = prepared.changed ? prepared.body : raw;
            return executeWithCsrfRetry(original, thisArg, nextArgs, targetUrl, replayBody, nextArgs[1]?.signal || (isRequestLike(nextArgs[0]) ? nextArgs[0].signal : null));
        }
        if (prepared.kind !== 'prepared') {
            const nextArgs = applySameOriginCsrfHeaders(targetUrl, args);
            return executeWithCsrfRetry(original, thisArg, nextArgs, targetUrl, raw, nextArgs[1]?.signal || (isRequestLike(nextArgs[0]) ? nextArgs[0].signal : null));
        }
        if (prepared.kind === 'prepared' && runtime.settings.toolTransport === true && !prepared.toolName && prepared.summary?.transportBypassReason) {
            const byp = String(prepared.summary.transportBypassReason);
            if (byp.startsWith('preset-own-carrier-active:')) {
                const cname = byp.slice('preset-own-carrier-active:'.length);
                notify('info', `检测到预设自带工具抗截断 (${cname}) 已开启，已自动交由预设原生工具承载`);
            } else if (byp !== 'non-main-request' && byp !== 'non-story-payload') {
                notify('warning', `本轮因请求限制 (${byp}) 自动退回普通流传输`);
            }
        }

        const run = createRun(prepared, args);
        const sameOrigin = isSameOriginUrl(targetUrl);
        const changedArgs = withBody(args, prepared.body);
        const extraHeaders = (!sameOrigin && runtime.settings.argonGuardEnabled) ? {
            'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, no-store, max-age=0, must-revalidate',
            'Pragma': 'no-cache',
            'X-Request-ID': genRandomHex('req', 3),
            'X-Session-ID': prepared.request?.user || genRandomHex('sess', 3),
        } : {};
        changedArgs[1] = {
            ...changedArgs[1],
            headers: buildMergedRequestHeaders(targetUrl, changedArgs[0], changedArgs[1], extraHeaders, typeof prepared.body === 'string'),
            ...(sameOrigin && !changedArgs[1]?.credentials ? { credentials: 'same-origin' } : {}),
            signal: run.signal,
        };
        try {
            const response = await executeWithCsrfRetry(original, thisArg, changedArgs, targetUrl, prepared.body, run.signal);
            run.headers(response);
            if (run.signal.aborted) { void response.body?.cancel().catch(() => {}); throw run.signal.reason; }

            if (!response.ok) {
                run.update({ endedCleanly: false, error: 'HTTP ' + response.status });
                if (response.body) return observeStream(response, run, false, false);
                run.finish({ endedCleanly: false, error: 'HTTP ' + response.status }); return response;
            }
            const contentType = (response.headers.get('content-type') || '').toLowerCase();
            if (!prepared.toolName) {
                if (response.body) {
                    const isSse = contentType.includes('text/event-stream') || prepared.stream;
                    if (isSse) {
                        const resilientResp = createResilientPlainSseResponse(response, prepared, run);
                        return observeStream(resilientResp, run, false, true);
                    }
                    const resilientJsonResp = await handleResilientPlainJsonResponse(response, run);
                    return observeStream(resilientJsonResp, run, false, false);
                }
                run.finish({ phase: 'headers-only', endedCleanly: null, semanticChecked: false, bodyObserved: false });
                return response;
            }
            if (!response.body) { run.finish({ endedCleanly: false, error: 'empty_body' }); return response; }
            if (contentType.includes('text/event-stream') || (prepared.stream && (contentType.includes('json') || !contentType))) {
                return observeStream(transformStreamResponse(response, prepared.toolName, run, prepared.trailingPrefillText || ''), run, true);
            }
            if (!contentType.includes('json')) {
                run.update({ error: 'unexpected_content_type', semanticChecked: false });
                return observeStream(response, run, false, false);
            }
            const result = await transformJsonResponse(response, prepared.toolName, run, prepared.trailingPrefillText || '');
            run.finish(result.stats);
            return result.response;
        } catch (error) {
            run.finish({ endedCleanly: false, cancelled: run.signal.aborted, ...(run.signal.aborted ? {} : failureDetails(error)) });
            throw error;
        }
    }

    function installFetch() {
        const targets = hostWindows();
        for (const target of targets) {
            const current = target?.fetch;
            if (typeof current !== 'function') continue;
            if (current[FETCH_MARKER]?.instanceId === INSTANCE_ID) continue;
            // 若晚加载的扩展（如 ST-BaiBai-Tools / Catiecli Tasks）覆盖了 window.fetch，先解绑旧内层包装再挂到最外层，避免双层拦截且确保本脚本始终先处理请求
            for (let i = runtime.fetchPatches.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const patch = runtime.fetchPatches[i];
                if (patch.target === target) {
                    patch.bypass = true;
                    runtime.fetchPatches.splice(i, 1);
                }
            }
            const original = current;
            const patchRecord = { target, original, wrapped: null, bypass: false };
            const wrapped = async function (...args) {
                if (runtime.disposed || patchRecord.bypass) return original.apply(this ?? target, args);
                const url = resolveUrl(args[0]);
                if (interceptionEnabled() && CHAT_ENDPOINT.test(url)) {
                    try {
                        return await handleGeneration(original, this ?? target, args);
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error(`[${SCRIPT_NAME}] generation request processing failed`, error);
                        throw error;
                    }
                }
                if (isSameOriginApiPath(url)) {
                    const nextArgs = applySameOriginCsrfHeaders(url, args);
                    return executeWithCsrfRetry(
                        original,
                        this ?? target,
                        nextArgs,
                        url,
                        null,
                        nextArgs[1]?.signal || (isRequestLike(nextArgs[0]) ? nextArgs[0].signal : null)
                    );
                }
                return original.apply(this ?? target, args);
            };
            wrapped[FETCH_MARKER] = { original, instanceId: INSTANCE_ID };
            patchRecord.wrapped = wrapped;
            target.fetch = wrapped;
            runtime.fetchPatches.push(patchRecord);
        }
        runtime.installed = runtime.fetchPatches.length > 0;
    }

    function removeFetch() {
        for (const patch of runtime.fetchPatches.splice(0)) {
            patch.bypass = true;
            try {
                if (patch.target?.fetch === patch.wrapped || patch.target?.fetch?.[FETCH_MARKER]?.instanceId === INSTANCE_ID) {
                    patch.target.fetch = patch.original;
                }
            } catch (_) {}
        }
        runtime.installed = false;
    }

    }

    function drainStops(list) {
        while (Array.isArray(list) && list.length) {
            try { list.pop()(); } catch (_) {}
        }
    }

    function clearPanelStops() {
        drainStops(runtime.panelStops);
    }

    function syncConfigPanelViewport() {
        const panel = runtime.panel;
        const view = panel?.ownerDocument?.defaultView;
        if (!panel || !view) return;
        const viewportHeight = Number(view.visualViewport?.height || view.innerHeight || 0);
        if (viewportHeight > 0) {
            panel.style.setProperty('--ufi-viewport-height', `${Math.round(viewportHeight)}px`);
        }
    }

    function closeConfigPanel() {
        const panel = runtime.panel;
        if (!panel) return;
        panel.classList.remove('visible');
        panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        const focusTarget = runtime.lastFocusedElement;
        runtime.lastFocusedElement = null;
        try { focusTarget?.focus?.({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (_) {}
    }

    function syncLauncherAppearance() {
        const btn = runtime.launcher;
        if (btn) {
            const active = runtime.settings.pluginEnabled !== false;
            const pluginOnly = active && isPluginOnlyBypassStoryMode();
            const imgEl = btn.querySelector('.ufi-fab-img');
            if (!imgEl || imgEl.getAttribute('src') !== LAUNCHER_ICON_DATA_URL) {
                btn.innerHTML = `<img class="ufi-fab-img" alt="" src="${LAUNCHER_ICON_DATA_URL}">`;
            }
            btn.dataset.state = !active ? 'off' : (pluginOnly ? 'plugin' : 'on');
            btn.title = active
                ? '双马尾插件：已开启（点一下打开控制台 / 拖动可移动 / 右键切换省流模式）'
                : '双马尾插件：省流直连中（点一下打开控制台 / 拖动可移动 / 右键一键开启）';
            btn.style.borderColor = active ? 'rgba(52,211,153,.85)' : 'rgba(251,191,36,.9)';
            btn.style.background = active ? 'linear-gradient(160deg,#0f2922,#141b27)' : 'linear-gradient(160deg,#33240d,#141b27)';
        }
        try { syncQrAndMenuIndicators(); } catch (_) {}
    }

    function getUiEntriesState() {
        return {
            floating: runtime.settings.entryFloatingEnabled !== false,
            qr: runtime.settings.entryQrEnabled !== false,
            menu: runtime.settings.entryMenuEnabled !== false,
        };
    }

    function setUiEntries(patch = {}, options = {}) {
        if (!patch || typeof patch !== 'object') return { ok: true, ...getUiEntriesState() };
        const prev = getUiEntriesState();
        const nextFloating = typeof patch.floating === 'boolean'
            ? patch.floating
            : (typeof patch.entryFloatingEnabled === 'boolean' ? patch.entryFloatingEnabled : prev.floating);
        const nextQr = typeof patch.qr === 'boolean'
            ? patch.qr
            : (typeof patch.entryQrEnabled === 'boolean' ? patch.entryQrEnabled : prev.qr);
        const nextMenu = typeof patch.menu === 'boolean'
            ? patch.menu
            : (typeof patch.entryMenuEnabled === 'boolean' ? patch.entryMenuEnabled : prev.menu);

        if (!nextFloating && !nextQr && !nextMenu) {
            syncConfigPanel();
            if (options.notify !== false) {
                notify('warning', '悬浮窗、QR 快捷栏和菜单栏至少必须启用一个入口');
            }
            return { ok: false, reason: 'at-least-one-required', ...prev };
        }

        runtime.settings.entryFloatingEnabled = nextFloating;
        runtime.settings.entryQrEnabled = nextQr;
        runtime.settings.entryMenuEnabled = nextMenu;
        saveSettings();
        syncLauncherEntries({ syncTavernButton: nextQr !== prev.qr });
        syncConfigPanel();
        return { ok: true, ...getUiEntriesState() };
    }

    function setPluginEnabled(enabled, options = {}) {
        runtime.settings.pluginEnabled = enabled === true;
        saveSettings();
        syncFetchInstallation();
        syncStPostProcessingForToolTransport();
        syncConfigPanel();
        if (options.notify !== false) {
            notify(
                'success',
                runtime.settings.pluginEnabled
                    ? '🛡 插件总开关已开启：防路由与抗截断生效中'
                    : '💰 插件总开关已关闭：已进入 0 额外 Token 省流直连模式'
            );
        }
        return runtime.settings.pluginEnabled;
    }

    function switchPanelTab(name) {
        const panel = runtime.panel;
        if (!panel) return;
        let target = name || 'guard';
        if (!panel.querySelector(`[data-tab="${target}"]`)) target = 'guard';
        runtime.panelTab = target;
        panel.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach(btn => {
            btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.tab === target);
        });
        panel.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(view => {
            view.classList.toggle('hide', view.dataset.view !== target);
        });
    }

    function escapeHtml(str) {
        return String(str ?? '')
            .replace(/&/g, '&')
            .replace(/</g, '<')
            .replace(/>/g, '>')
            .replace(/"/g, '"')
            .replace(/'/g, ''');
    }

    function syncConfigPanel() {
        syncLauncherAppearance();
        const panel = runtime.panel;
        if (!panel) return;

        const masterOn = runtime.settings.pluginEnabled !== false;
        const masterRow = panel.querySelector('[data-role="masterCard"]');
        const masterSwitch = panel.querySelector('[data-role="pluginEnabled"]');
        const masterBadge = panel.querySelector('[data-role="masterState"]');
        const subWrap = panel.querySelector('[data-role="subControlsWrap"]');
        const headDot = panel.querySelector('[data-role="headDot"]');
        const headState = panel.querySelector('[data-role="headState"]');

        if (masterSwitch) masterSwitch.checked = masterOn;
        if (masterRow) masterRow.classList.toggle('off', !masterOn);
        if (masterBadge) {
            masterBadge.textContent = masterOn ? '已开启' : '已关闭';
            masterBadge.className = 'ufi-state' + (masterOn ? '' : ' saving');
        }
        if (headDot) headDot.classList.toggle('off', !masterOn);
        if (headState) headState.textContent = masterOn ? '运行中 · 防路由与抗截断已生效' : '已关闭 · 请求原样直连';
        if (subWrap) {
            subWrap.style.opacity = masterOn ? '1' : '0.4';
            subWrap.style.pointerEvents = masterOn ? 'auto' : 'none';
        }

        const autoBypassVertex = panel.querySelector('[data-role="autoBypassVertex"]');
        if (autoBypassVertex) autoBypassVertex.checked = runtime.settings.autoBypassVertex !== false;

        const modelCtx = resolveModelContext(null, '');
        const matchedProf = modelCtx.matchedProfile;
        const detectedName = modelCtx.detectedModel;
        const modelValueEl = panel.querySelector('[data-role="detectedModelDesc"]');
        const hLevelSel = panel.querySelector('[data-role="hydrogenThinkingLevel"]');

        const profileLevels = {
            '4h': ['auto', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh'],
            '4c': ['auto', 'low', 'medium', 'high'],
            '4a': ['low', 'high'],
            '38f': ['auto', 'low', 'medium', 'high'],
        };
        const allowedLevels = matchedProf ? profileLevels[matchedProf] : null;

        if (modelValueEl) {
            modelValueEl.textContent = detectedName || '未读取到酒馆当前模型';
            modelValueEl.title = detectedName || '';
            modelValueEl.classList.toggle('muted', !detectedName);
        }
        if (hLevelSel) {
            if (allowedLevels) {
                let curVal = runtime.settings.hydrogenThinkingLevel || 'auto';
                if (!allowedLevels.includes(curVal)) {
                    if (matchedProf === '4a') {
                        curVal = (curVal === 'high' || curVal === 'xhigh') ? 'high' : 'low';
                    } else if (curVal === 'xhigh') {
                        curVal = 'high';
                    } else {
                        curVal = allowedLevels[0];
                    }
                }
                hLevelSel.innerHTML = allowedLevels
                    .map(level => `<option value="${level}">${level}</option>`)
                    .join('');
                hLevelSel.value = curVal;
                hLevelSel.disabled = false;
            } else {
                hLevelSel.innerHTML = '<option value="low">未读取到匹配模型</option>';
                hLevelSel.value = 'low';
                hLevelSel.disabled = true;
            }
        }

        const extEnabled = runtime.settings.externalPluginEnabled === true;
        const extOnly = runtime.settings.externalPluginOnly === true;
        const extSwitch = panel.querySelector('[data-role="externalPluginEnabled"]');
        const extBox = panel.querySelector('[data-role="externalPluginBox"]');
        const extOnlySwitch = panel.querySelector('[data-role="externalPluginOnly"]');
        const storyOnlyWrap = panel.querySelector('[data-role="storyOnlyControlsWrap"]');
        const extNote = panel.querySelector('[data-role="extModeNote"]');
        if (extSwitch) extSwitch.checked = extEnabled;
        if (extBox) extBox.classList.toggle('open', extEnabled);
        if (extOnlySwitch) extOnlySwitch.checked = extOnly;
        if (storyOnlyWrap) {
            const bypassStory = extEnabled && extOnly;
            storyOnlyWrap.style.opacity = bypassStory ? '0.45' : '1';
            storyOnlyWrap.style.pointerEvents = bypassStory ? 'none' : 'auto';
        }
        if (extNote) {
            extNote.textContent = !extEnabled
                ? '未接管插件请求'
                : (runtime.settings.externalPluginMode === 'full_inject' ? '路由 + 破限' : '仅防路由');
        }
        panel.querySelectorAll('input[name="ufi-ext-mode"]').forEach(radio => {
            const checked = radio.value === runtime.settings.externalPluginMode;
            radio.checked = checked;
            radio.closest('.ufi-choice')?.classList.toggle('active', checked);
        });

        const toolOn = runtime.settings.toolTransport === true;
        const toolSwitch = panel.querySelector('[data-role="toolTransport"]');
        if (toolSwitch) toolSwitch.checked = toolOn;

        const escOn = runtime.settings.inputEscapeEnabled === true;
        const escSwitch = panel.querySelector('[data-role="inputEscapeEnabled"]');
        const escBox = panel.querySelector('[data-role="inputEscapeBox"]');
        if (escSwitch) escSwitch.checked = escOn;
        if (escBox) escBox.classList.toggle('open', escOn);
        panel.querySelectorAll('input[name="ufi-input-mode"]').forEach(radio => {
            const checked = radio.value === runtime.settings.inputMode;
            radio.checked = checked;
            radio.closest('.ufi-choice')?.classList.toggle('active', checked);
        });

        const prefillSwitch = panel.querySelector('[data-role="preserveTrailingPrefill"]');
        if (prefillSwitch) prefillSwitch.checked = runtime.settings.preserveTrailingPrefill === true;

        const entryState = getUiEntriesState();
        const enabledEntryCount = [entryState.floating, entryState.qr, entryState.menu].filter(Boolean).length;
        const entryCountBadge = panel.querySelector('[data-role="entryTabCount"]');
        if (entryCountBadge) entryCountBadge.textContent = String(enabledEntryCount);
        for (const [key, role, enabled] of [
            ['floating', 'entryFloatingEnabled', entryState.floating],
            ['qr', 'entryQrEnabled', entryState.qr],
            ['menu', 'entryMenuEnabled', entryState.menu],
        ]) {
            const input = panel.querySelector(`[data-role="${role}"]`);
            if (input) input.checked = enabled;
            const row = panel.querySelector(`[data-role="entryRow-${key}"]`);
            if (row) row.classList.toggle('active', enabled);
            const lock = panel.querySelector(`[data-role="entryLock-${key}"]`);
            if (lock) lock.style.display = enabled && enabledEntryCount <= 1 ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
        }

        const autoUpdateSwitch = panel.querySelector('[data-role="autoUpdateEnabled"]');
        const autoUpdateOn = runtime.settings.autoUpdateEnabled !== false;
        if (autoUpdateSwitch) autoUpdateSwitch.checked = autoUpdateOn;
        const updateBadge = panel.querySelector('[data-role="updateBadge"]');
        const updateMsg = panel.querySelector('[data-role="updateStatusText"]');
        const updateTabState = panel.querySelector('[data-role="updateTabState"]');
        const checkBtn = panel.querySelector('[data-action="checkUpdate"]');
        const reloadBtn = panel.querySelector('[data-action="reloadForUpdate"]');
        const st = runtime.updateState || {};
        let tagText = '已是最新';
        let tabText = autoUpdateOn ? '开' : '关';
        if (st.status === 'checking') { tagText = '检查中…'; tabText = '…'; }
        else if (st.status === 'updated') { tagText = '已更新，待刷新'; tabText = '新'; }
        else if (st.status === 'up-to-date') { tagText = '已是最新'; }
        else if (st.status === 'manual-required' || st.status === 'not-installed') {
            tagText = '有新版 v' + (st.latestVersion || VERSION);
            tabText = '新';
        }
        else if (st.status === 'error') { tagText = '离线 / 检查失败'; }
        if (updateBadge) updateBadge.textContent = tagText;
        if (updateTabState) updateTabState.textContent = tabText;
        if (updateMsg) updateMsg.textContent = st.message || ('当前 v' + VERSION + ' · 等待检查');
        if (checkBtn) {
            checkBtn.disabled = st.status === 'checking';
            checkBtn.textContent = st.status === 'checking' ? '正在检查…' : '立即检查';
        }
        if (reloadBtn) {
            reloadBtn.style.display = st.needsReload ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
            reloadBtn.style.alignItems = 'center';
        }

        const logCountBadge = panel.querySelector('[data-role="logTabCount"]');
        if (logCountBadge) logCountBadge.textContent = String(runtime.runHistory.length);
        const logListEl = panel.querySelector('[data-role="logList"]');
        if (logListEl) {
            if (!runtime.runHistory.length) {
                logListEl.innerHTML = '<div class="ufi-log-empty">暂无生成记录，发送一条消息后自动在此显示详情</div>';
            } else {
                const escMap = {
                    json_escape: '一·整包 \uXXXX',
                    compact: '二·码点 ⟦U:...⟧',
                    hybrid_image: '三·转图片',
                    full_armor: '四·深度破盾',
                    off: '未开启',
                };
                logListEl.innerHTML = runtime.runHistory.map(item => {
                    const isStory = item.requestTier === 'story';
                    const isActive = runtime.activeRuns.has(item.id);
                    const isErr = !isActive && (item.phase === 'error' || item.error);
                    const isCancelled = !isActive && (item.phase === 'cancelled' || item.cancelled) && !(item.recoveredChars > 0);
                    const cardCls = isErr || isCancelled ? 'ufi-log-card err' : (isStory ? 'ufi-log-card story' : 'ufi-log-card plugin');
                    const d = new Date(item.time || Date.now());
                    const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
                    const timeStr = `${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}:${pad(d.getSeconds())}`;
                    const tierChip = isStory
                        ? '<span class="ufi-chip">正文请求</span>'
                        : '<span class="ufi-chip gray">插件/后台</span>';
                    let stateChip = '<span class="ufi-chip">✅ 完成</span>';
                    if (isActive) {
                        stateChip = '<span class="ufi-chip warn">🟢 流式传输中…</span>';
                    } else if (isErr) {
                        stateChip = `<span class="ufi-chip warn">⚠️ 异常 (${escapeHtml(item.error || '中断')})</span>`;
                    } else if (isCancelled) {
                        stateChip = '<span class="ufi-chip gray">⏹ 手动停止</span>';
                    }
                    const toolStatus = item.outputMode === 'tool'
                        ? (item.syntheticHit
                            ? '✅ 已注入并命中剥壳'
                            : (isActive ? '⏳ 已注入 (等待首包命中)' : '⚠️ 已注入但上游未调用工具'))
                        : (item.transportBypassReason && item.transportBypassReason !== 'transport-disabled'
                            ? `未注入 (${escapeHtml(item.transportBypassReason)})`
                            : '未开启');
                    const escStatus = escMap[item.inputMode] || '未开启';
                    const ttftStr = item.firstContentMs != null
                        ? (item.firstContentMs / 1000).toFixed(1) + 's'
                        : (item.firstByteMs != null ? (item.firstByteMs / 1000).toFixed(1) + 's (首字节)' : '等待中');
                    const durStr = ((item.duration || 0) / 1000).toFixed(1) + 's';
                    const libStr = `Sys:${item.textLibraryPromptMatches || 0} / User:${item.textLibraryUserMatches || 0}`;
                    const sysDemoteStr = item.demotedSystemCount ? `已降权 ${item.demotedSystemCount} 条` : '保持原样';
                    const extraNotes = [];
                    if (item.finishReasons?.length) extraNotes.push('结束原因: ' + item.finishReasons.join(','));
                    if (item.errorMessage) extraNotes.push('详情: ' + item.errorMessage);
                    if (item.warning) extraNotes.push('提示: ' + item.warning);
                    return [
                        `<div class="${cardCls}">`,
                        '<div class="ufi-log-top">',
                        `<span>#${item.id}</span>`,
                        tierChip,
                        stateChip,
                        `<span class="ufi-log-time">${timeStr}</span>`,
                        '</div>',
                        '<div class="ufi-log-grid">',
                        `<div>工具抗截断：<b>${toolStatus}</b></div>`,
                        `<div>输入转义：<b>${escStatus}</b></div>`,
                        `<div>模型/思考：<b>${escapeHtml(item.detectedModel || item.modelProfile || '未知')} (${escapeHtml(item.effortMode || 'auto')})</b></div>`,
                        `<div>实收字数：<b>${item.recoveredChars || 0} 字</b> (${item.upstreamRecords || 0} 帧)</div>`,
                        `<div>首字/总耗时：<b>${ttftStr} / ${durStr}</b></div>`,
                        `<div>稀释库/Sys：<b>${libStr} · ${sysDemoteStr}</b></div>`,
                        '</div>',
                        extraNotes.length ? `<div class="ufi-log-foot">${escapeHtml(extraNotes.join(' | '))}</div>` : '',
                        '</div>',
                    ].join('');
                }).join('');
            }
        }

        const statusEl = panel.querySelector('[data-role="status"]');
        if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = runDescription(runtime.lastRun);
    }

    function mountConfigPanel() {
        const doc = hostDocument();
        if (!doc?.body) return false;
        if (
            runtime.panel?.isConnected
            && runtime.panel.ownerDocument === doc
            && runtime.style?.isConnected
            && runtime.style.ownerDocument === doc
        ) {
            syncConfigPanelViewport();
            return true;
        }

        clearPanelStops();
        try { runtime.panel?.remove?.(); } catch (_) {}
        try { runtime.style?.remove?.(); } catch (_) {}
        runtime.panel = null;
        runtime.style = null;

        doc.getElementById(PANEL_ID)?.remove();
        doc.getElementById(STYLE_ID)?.remove();
        const style = doc.createElement('style');
        style.id = STYLE_ID;
        style.dataset.instanceId = INSTANCE_ID;
        style.textContent = configPanelCss();
        (doc.head || doc.documentElement).appendChild(style);
        runtime.style = style;

        const panel = doc.createElement('div');
        panel.id = PANEL_ID;
        panel.dataset.instanceId = INSTANCE_ID;
        panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        panel.innerHTML = [
            '<div class="ufi-frame" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="ufi-panel-title">',
            '<header class="ufi-head">',
            '<div class="ufi-head-text">',
            '<div class="ufi-title" id="ufi-panel-title">双马尾插件</div>',
            '<div class="ufi-sub"><span class="ufi-dot" data-role="headDot"></span><span data-role="headState">运行中 · 防路由与抗截断已生效</span></div>',

        const onClick = event => {

            const closeTarget = event.target?.closest?.('[data-action="close"]');

                closeConfigPanel();
                return;
            }
            const refreshModelBtn = event.target?.closest?.('[data-action="refreshModel"]');

                syncConfigPanel();

                if (ctx.matchedProfile) {
                    notify('success', `已读取酒馆模型：${ctx.detectedModel}（匹配 ${ctx.matchedProfile.toUpperCase()}）`);
                } else {
                    notify('warning', ctx.detectedModel ? `未匹配已知架构：${ctx.detectedModel}` : '未读取到酒馆当前模型');
                }
                return;
            }
            const clearLogsBtn = event.target?.closest?.('[data-action="clearLogs"]');
            if (clearLogsBtn) {
                runtime.runHistory.length = 0;
                runtime.lastRun = null;
                syncConfigPanel();
                notify('info', '已清空请求日志');
                return;
            }
            const checkBtn = event.target?.closest?.('[data-action="checkUpdate"]');
            if (checkBtn) {
                checkForUpdate({ manual: true }).catch(() => {});
                return;
            }
            const reloadBtn = event.target?.closest?.('[data-action="reloadForUpdate"]');
            if (reloadBtn) {
                if (runtime.activeRuns.size > 0) {
                    notify('warning', '当前仍有生成请求正在进行，请稍候完成后再刷新页面');
                    return;
                }
                try {
                    const host = rootWindow();
                    if (typeof host?.location?.reload === 'function') host.location.reload();
                } catch (_) {}

        const onChange = event => {
            const target = event.target;
            if (target?.matches?.('[data-role="pluginEnabled"]')) setPluginEnabled(target.checked);

    // ==================== [酒馆提示词后处理与函数调用同步（独立实现）] ====================
    const ST_POSTPROCESS_BACKUP_KEY = 'st-4a-guard:tool-postprocess-backup:v1';
    const LEGACY_POSTPROCESS_BACKUP_KEY = 'izumi4a-genesis-guard:postprocess-prev:v1';
    const TOOL_COMPATIBLE_POSTPROCESS = new Set(['', 'merge_tools', 'semi_tools', 'strict_tools']);
    const TOOL_POSTPROCESS_UPGRADE_MAP = Object.freeze({ merge: 'merge_tools', semi: 'semi_tools' });

    function readBackupRecord(store) {
        if (!store) return null;
        for (const key of [ST_POSTPROCESS_BACKUP_KEY, LEGACY_POSTPROCESS_BACKUP_KEY]) {
            try {
                const raw = store.getItem(key);
                if (!raw) continue;
                const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
                if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') return parsed;
            } catch (_) {}
        }
        return null;
    }

    function clearBackupRecords(store) {
        if (!store) return;
        for (const key of [ST_POSTPROCESS_BACKUP_KEY, LEGACY_POSTPROCESS_BACKUP_KEY]) {
            try { store.removeItem(key); } catch (_) {}
        }
    }

    function syncStPostProcessingForToolTransport() {
        try {
            const stCtx = parentWin.SillyTavern?.getContext?.() || globalThis.SillyTavern?.getContext?.();
            const oaiSettings = stCtx?.chatCompletionSettings;
            if (!oaiSettings) return;
            const doc = hostDocument();
            const EvCtor = doc?.defaultView?.Event || (typeof Event === 'function' ? Event : null);
            const postSel = doc?.getElementById?.('custom_prompt_post_processing');
            const fcCheck = doc?.getElementById?.('function_calling');
            const csrfReady = hasHostCsrfToken();

            const updateSelectAndSetting = nextVal => {
                if (postSel) {
                    const hasOpt = !postSel.options?.length || Array.from(postSel.options).some(opt => opt.value === nextVal);
                    if (!hasOpt) return false;
                    if (postSel.value !== nextVal) {
                        postSel.value = nextVal;
                        if (csrfReady && EvCtor) postSel.dispatchEvent(new EvCtor('change', { bubbles: true }));
                    }
                }
                const changed = oaiSettings.custom_prompt_post_processing !== nextVal;
                oaiSettings.custom_prompt_post_processing = nextVal;
                if (changed && csrfReady) {
                    try { stCtx.saveSettingsDebounced?.(); } catch (_) {}
                }
                return true;
            };

            const updateFunctionCalling = nextFlag => {
                const enabled = Boolean(nextFlag);
                let changed = oaiSettings.function_calling !== enabled;
                oaiSettings.function_calling = enabled;
                if (fcCheck && fcCheck.checked !== enabled) {
                    fcCheck.checked = enabled;
                    changed = true;
                    if (csrfReady && EvCtor) fcCheck.dispatchEvent(new EvCtor('change', { bubbles: true }));
                }
                if (changed && csrfReady) {
                    try { stCtx.saveSettingsDebounced?.(); } catch (_) {}
                }
            };

            const needToolCompat = runtime.settings.pluginEnabled !== false
                && runtime.settings.toolTransport === true
                && !isPluginOnlyBypassStoryMode();
            const store = settingsStorage();

            if (needToolCompat) {
                const backup = readBackupRecord(store) || {};
                let dirty = false;
                const currentMode = typeof oaiSettings.custom_prompt_post_processing === 'string'
                    ? oaiSettings.custom_prompt_post_processing
                    : '';
                if (!TOOL_COMPATIBLE_POSTPROCESS.has(currentMode)) {
                    const targetMode = TOOL_POSTPROCESS_UPGRADE_MAP[currentMode] || 'strict_tools';
                    backup.value = currentMode;
                    backup.mapped = targetMode;
                    dirty = true;
                    updateSelectAndSetting(targetMode);
                }
                if (!oaiSettings.function_calling || (fcCheck && fcCheck.checked === false)) {
                    backup.prevFunctionCalling = Boolean(oaiSettings.function_calling);
                    dirty = true;
                    updateFunctionCalling(true);
                }
                if (dirty && store) {
                    try { store.setItem(ST_POSTPROCESS_BACKUP_KEY, JSON.stringify(backup)); } catch (_) {}
                    try { store.removeItem(LEGACY_POSTPROCESS_BACKUP_KEY); } catch (_) {}
                }
                return;
            }

            const saved = readBackupRecord(store);
            if (saved) {
                clearBackupRecords(store);
                if (typeof saved.value === 'string' && (!saved.mapped || oaiSettings.custom_prompt_post_processing === saved.mapped)) {
                    updateSelectAndSetting(saved.value);
                }
                if (typeof saved.prevFunctionCalling === 'boolean') {
                    updateFunctionCalling(saved.prevFunctionCalling);
                }
            }
        } catch (_) {}
    }

    function setToolTransport(enabled, options = {}) {
        runtime.settings.toolTransport = enabled === true;
        saveSettings();
        syncFetchInstallation();
        syncStPostProcessingForToolTransport();
        syncConfigPanel();
        if (options.notify !== false) notify('success', `工具调用抗截断已${runtime.settings.toolTransport ? '开启（已同步启用酒馆函数调用）' : '关闭'}`);
        return runtime.settings.toolTransport;
    }

    function setInputMode(mode, options = {}) {

            return runtime.settings.inputMode;
