        saveSettings();
        syncFetchInstallation();
        syncConfigPanel();
        if (options.notify !== false) {
            const names = {
                json_escape: '整包 JSON \uXXXX 隐形转义',
                compact: '当轮输入 ⟦U:...⟧ 紧凑码点转码',
                hybrid_image: 'Canvas 转图片混合模式',
                full_armor: '全上下文高敏词 ⟦U:...⟧ + 整包 \uXXXX 深度破盾',
            };
            notify('success', runtime.settings.inputEscapeEnabled ? `输入转义模式：${names[runtime.settings.inputMode]}` : '输入转义已关闭');
        }
        return runtime.settings.inputMode;
    }

    function setTextLibraryPromptEnabled(enabled) {
        runtime.settings.textLibraryPromptEnabled = Boolean(enabled);
        return runtime.settings.textLibraryPromptEnabled;
    }
    function setTextLibraryUserInputEnabled(enabled) {
        runtime.settings.textLibraryUserInputEnabled = Boolean(enabled);
        return runtime.settings.textLibraryUserInputEnabled;
    }
    function setSystemPromptSlot(slot) {
        runtime.textLibrary.systemPromptSlot = normalizeTextLibrarySlot(slot);
        syncActiveTextLibraryValues();
        saveTextLibrary();
        return runtime.textLibrary.systemPromptSlot;
    }
    function setUserInputSlot(slot) {
        runtime.textLibrary.userInputSlot = normalizeTextLibrarySlot(slot);
        syncActiveTextLibraryValues();
        saveTextLibrary();
        return runtime.textLibrary.userInputSlot;
    }
    function saveSystemPromptText(value, options = {}) {
        const slot = normalizeTextLibrarySlot(options.slot ?? runtime.textLibrary.systemPromptSlot);
        if (slot === 0) return textLibraryDefaultText('system');
        runtime.textLibrary.systemPromptSlot = slot;
        runtime.textLibrary.systemPromptSlots[slot - 1] = String(value ?? '');
        syncActiveTextLibraryValues();
        saveTextLibrary();
        return runtime.textLibrary.systemPromptText;
    }
    function saveUserInputText(value, options = {}) {
        const slot = normalizeTextLibrarySlot(options.slot ?? runtime.textLibrary.userInputSlot);
        if (slot === 0) return textLibraryDefaultText('user');
        runtime.textLibrary.userInputSlot = slot;
        runtime.textLibrary.userInputSlots[slot - 1] = String(value ?? '');
        syncActiveTextLibraryValues();
        saveTextLibrary();
        return runtime.textLibrary.userInputText;
    }
    function saveSystemPromptSlot(slot, value, options = {}) {
        return saveSystemPromptText(value, { ...options, slot });
    }
    function saveUserInputSlot(slot, value, options = {}) {
        return saveUserInputText(value, { ...options, slot });
    }

    const FAB_POS_KEY = 'izumi4a-genesis-guard:fab-pos:v2';
    const FAB_SIZE = 48;
    const FAB_MARGIN = 6;
    const FAB_DEFAULT_RIGHT = 14;
    const FAB_DEFAULT_BOTTOM = 96;

    function clampFabPos(doc, x, y) {
        const view = doc?.defaultView;
        const vw = Number(view?.innerWidth || 0);
        const vh = Number(view?.innerHeight || 0);
        const maxX = Math.max(FAB_MARGIN, vw - FAB_SIZE - FAB_MARGIN);
        const maxY = Math.max(FAB_MARGIN, vh - FAB_SIZE - FAB_MARGIN);
        const nx = Number.isFinite(x) ? Math.round(x) : maxX;
        const ny = Number.isFinite(y) ? Math.round(y) : maxY;
        return {
            x: Math.min(maxX, Math.max(FAB_MARGIN, nx)),
            y: Math.min(maxY, Math.max(FAB_MARGIN, ny)),
        };
    }

    function readFabPos() {
        try {
            const saved = JSON.parse(settingsStorage()?.getItem(FAB_POS_KEY) || 'null');
            if (saved && typeof saved === 'object') return saved;
        } catch (_) {}
        return null;
    }

    function saveFabPos(x, y) {
        try {
            settingsStorage()?.setItem(FAB_POS_KEY, JSON.stringify({
                x: Math.round(x),
                y: Math.round(y),
            }));
        } catch (_) {}
    }

    function defaultFabPos(doc) {
        const view = doc?.defaultView;
        const vw = Number(view?.innerWidth || 1280);
        const vh = Number(view?.innerHeight || 800);
        return clampFabPos(doc, vw - FAB_SIZE - FAB_DEFAULT_RIGHT, vh - FAB_SIZE - FAB_DEFAULT_BOTTOM);
    }

    function placeFab(button, pos) {
        button.style.left = pos.x + 'px';
        button.style.top = pos.y + 'px';
        button.style.right = 'auto';
        button.style.bottom = 'auto';
    }

    function updateFabStatus() {
        const el = runtime.panel?.querySelector?.('[data-role="fabStatus"]');
        if (!el) return;
        if (runtime.settings.entryFloatingEnabled === false) {
            el.textContent = '悬浮球：入口开关已关闭，打开开关后立刻出现';
            return;
        }
        const doc = hostDocument();
        const btn = runtime.launcher && runtime.launcher.isConnected
            ? runtime.launcher
            : doc?.getElementById?.(FALLBACK_LAUNCHER_ID);
        if (!btn) {
            el.textContent = '悬浮球：未挂载到页面（每 4 秒自动重试一次）';
            return;
        }
        const view = doc?.defaultView;
        const vw = Number(view?.innerWidth || 0);
        const vh = Number(view?.innerHeight || 0);
        const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
        let covered = false;
        try {
            const top = doc.elementFromPoint(rect.left + rect.width / 2, rect.top + rect.height / 2);
            covered = top ? !(top === btn || btn.contains(top)) : true;
        } catch (_) {}
        el.textContent = `悬浮球：已挂载 · 屏幕 ${vw}×${vh} · 位置 ${Math.round(rect.left)},${Math.round(rect.top)}`
            + (covered ? ' · 被其它元素遮挡' : '');
    }

    function unmountFallbackLauncher() {
        drainStops(runtime.floatingStops);
        try { runtime.launcher?.remove?.(); } catch (_) {}
        try { hostDocument()?.getElementById?.(FALLBACK_LAUNCHER_ID)?.remove?.(); } catch (_) {}
        runtime.launcher = null;
    }

    function mountFallbackLauncher() {
        if (runtime.settings.entryFloatingEnabled === false) {
            unmountFallbackLauncher();
            return false;
        }
        const doc = hostDocument();
        if (!doc?.body) return false;
        unmountFallbackLauncher();
        if (!doc.getElementById(STYLE_ID)) {
            const style = doc.createElement('style');
            style.id = STYLE_ID;
            style.dataset.instanceId = INSTANCE_ID;
            style.textContent = configPanelCss();
            (doc.head || doc.documentElement).appendChild(style);
            runtime.style = style;
        }
        const button = doc.createElement('button');
        button.id = FALLBACK_LAUNCHER_ID;
        button.dataset.instanceId = INSTANCE_ID;
        button.type = 'button';
        button.setAttribute('aria-label', '打开双马尾插件控制台（拖动可移动 / 右键切换省流模式）');

        // 位置：优先用存档坐标，其次兼容旧版 {dock,right,bottom} 存档，最后落在右下角
        const saved = readFabPos();
        let pos;
        if (saved && typeof saved.x === 'number' && typeof saved.y === 'number') {
            pos = clampFabPos(doc, saved.x, saved.y);
        } else if (saved && (typeof saved.right === 'number' || typeof saved.bottom === 'number')) {
            const view = doc.defaultView;
            const vw = Number(view?.innerWidth || 1280);
            const vh = Number(view?.innerHeight || 800);
            const right = typeof saved.right === 'number' ? saved.right : FAB_DEFAULT_RIGHT;
            const bottom = typeof saved.bottom === 'number' ? saved.bottom : FAB_DEFAULT_BOTTOM;
            pos = clampFabPos(doc, vw - FAB_SIZE - right, vh - FAB_SIZE - bottom);
        } else {
            pos = defaultFabPos(doc);
        }
        placeFab(button, pos);

        // 拖拽：鼠标与触摸各挂一套，位移超过 5px 才算拖动，否则松手就打开控制台
        let drag = null;
        let lastTapAt = 0;
        const onDown = ev => {
            if (ev.type === 'mousedown' && ev.button !== 0) return;
            const p = ev.touches ? ev.touches[0] : ev;
            if (!p) return;
            drag = {
                sx: p.clientX,
                sy: p.clientY,
                ox: parseFloat(button.style.left) || 0,
                oy: parseFloat(button.style.top) || 0,
                moved: false,
            };
        };
        const onMove = ev => {
            if (!drag) return;
            const p = ev.touches ? ev.touches[0] : ev;
            if (!p) return;
            const dx = p.clientX - drag.sx;
            const dy = p.clientY - drag.sy;
            if (!drag.moved && Math.abs(dx) < 5 && Math.abs(dy) < 5) return;
            drag.moved = true;
            if (ev.cancelable) ev.preventDefault();
            placeFab(button, clampFabPos(doc, drag.ox + dx, drag.oy + dy));
        };
        const onUp = () => {
            if (!drag) return;
            const wasMoved = drag.moved;
            drag = null;
            if (wasMoved) {
                saveFabPos(parseFloat(button.style.left) || 0, parseFloat(button.style.top) || 0);
                return;
            }
            const now = Date.now();
            if (now - lastTapAt < 350) return;
            lastTapAt = now;
            openConfigPanel();
        };
        const onContext = ev => {
            ev.preventDefault?.();
            ev.stopPropagation?.();
            setPluginEnabled(!(runtime.settings.pluginEnabled !== false));
        };
        button.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
        button.addEventListener('touchstart', onDown, { passive: true });
        button.addEventListener('contextmenu', onContext);
        doc.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
        doc.addEventListener('touchmove', onMove, { passive: false });
        doc.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
        doc.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
        doc.body.appendChild(button);
        runtime.launcher = button;
        syncLauncherAppearance();

        // 挂载后自检：尺寸为 0 或整颗跑出视口时，拉回右下角
        const verifyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            if (!button.isConnected) return;
            const view = doc.defaultView;
            const vw = Number(view?.innerWidth || 0);
            const vh = Number(view?.innerHeight || 0);
            const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect();
            const lost = rect.width < 8 || rect.height < 8
                || rect.right <= 8 || rect.left >= vw - 8 || rect.bottom <= 8 || rect.top >= vh - 8;
            if (!lost) return;
            const fix = defaultFabPos(doc);
            placeFab(button, fix);
            saveFabPos(fix.x, fix.y);
        }, 600);
        runtime.floatingStops.push(() => {
            clearTimeout(verifyTimer);
            button.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
            button.removeEventListener('touchstart', onDown);
            button.removeEventListener('contextmenu', onContext);
            doc.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
            doc.removeEventListener('touchmove', onMove);
            doc.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
            doc.removeEventListener('touchend', onUp);
        });
        return true;
    }

    const QR_DOM_BTN_ID = 'ufi-qr-bar-btn';
    const EXT_MENU_ITEM_ID = 'ufi-ext-menu-item';

    function toolbarApi() {
        // 兼容 TavernHelper 4.x 新旧全局与对象挂载方式
        const pick = (primary, secondary, name) => {
            if (typeof primary?.[name] === 'function') return primary[name].bind(primary);
            if (typeof secondary?.[name] === 'function') return secondary[name].bind(secondary);
            return null;
        };
        try {
            const thLocal = typeof TavernHelper !== 'undefined' ? TavernHelper : null;
            const evOn = typeof eventOn === 'function' ? eventOn : pick(thLocal, null, 'eventOn');
            const getBtnEv = typeof getButtonEvent === 'function' ? getButtonEvent : pick(thLocal, null, 'getButtonEvent');
            const appendBtn = typeof appendInexistentScriptButtons === 'function'
                ? appendInexistentScriptButtons
                : (typeof replaceScriptButtons === 'function'
                    ? btns => replaceScriptButtons(btns)
                    : (pick(thLocal, null, 'appendInexistentScriptButtons') || pick(thLocal, null, 'replaceScriptButtons')));
            const getBtns = typeof getScriptButtons === 'function' ? getScriptButtons : pick(thLocal, null, 'getScriptButtons');
            const replaceBtns = typeof replaceScriptButtons === 'function' ? replaceScriptButtons : pick(thLocal, null, 'replaceScriptButtons');
            if (typeof evOn === 'function' && typeof getBtnEv === 'function') {
                return {
                    appendButtons: typeof appendBtn === 'function' ? appendBtn : null,
                    getButtons: typeof getBtns === 'function' ? getBtns : null,
                    replaceButtons: typeof replaceBtns === 'function' ? replaceBtns : null,
                    getButtonEvent: getBtnEv,
                    eventOn: evOn,
                };
            }
        } catch (_) {}
        for (const host of hostWindows()) {
            try {
                const thObj = host?.TavernHelper || null;
                const evOn = pick(host, thObj, 'eventOn');
                const getBtnEv = pick(host, thObj, 'getButtonEvent');
                if (evOn && getBtnEv) {
                    return {
                        appendButtons: pick(host, thObj, 'appendInexistentScriptButtons') || pick(host, thObj, 'replaceScriptButtons'),
                        getButtons: pick(host, thObj, 'getScriptButtons'),
                        replaceButtons: pick(host, thObj, 'replaceScriptButtons'),
                        getButtonEvent: getBtnEv,
                        eventOn: evOn,
                    };
                }
            } catch (_) {}
        }
        return null;
    }

    function migrateLegacyScriptButtons(buttons) {
        if (!Array.isArray(buttons)) return { buttons, changed: false };
        const hasCurrent = buttons.some(btn => btn && btn.name === LAUNCHER_BUTTON_NAME);
        let changed = false;
        const next = [];
        for (const btn of buttons) {
            if (btn && btn.name === LEGACY_LAUNCHER_BUTTON_NAME) {
                changed = true;
                if (!hasCurrent) {
                    next.push({ ...btn, name: LAUNCHER_BUTTON_NAME });
                }
                continue;
            }
            next.push(btn);
        }
        return { buttons: changed ? next : buttons, changed };
    }

    function syncTavernScriptButtonVisibility(visible) {
        try {
            const api = toolbarApi();
            if (!api?.replaceButtons) return false;
            const wantVisible = visible !== false;
            const current = typeof api.getButtons === 'function' ? api.getButtons() : null;
            if (Array.isArray(current)) {
                const migrated = migrateLegacyScriptButtons(current);
                let changed = migrated.changed;
                let found = false;
                const next = migrated.buttons.map(btn => {
                    if (btn && btn.name === LAUNCHER_BUTTON_NAME) {
                        found = true;
                        if (Boolean(btn.visible) !== wantVisible) {
                            changed = true;
                            return { ...btn, visible: wantVisible };
                        }
                    }
                    return btn;
                });
                if (!found && wantVisible) {
                    next.push({ name: LAUNCHER_BUTTON_NAME, visible: true });
                    changed = true;
                }
                if (changed) api.replaceButtons(next);
                return true;
            }
            api.replaceButtons([{ name: LAUNCHER_BUTTON_NAME, visible: wantVisible }]);
            return true;
        } catch (_) {}
        return false;
    }

    function unmountQrButton() {
        drainStops(runtime.qrStops);
        const doc = hostDocument();
        try { doc?.getElementById?.(QR_DOM_BTN_ID)?.remove?.(); } catch (_) {}
        try {
            const customBar = doc?.getElementById?.('ufi-custom-qr-strip');
            if (customBar && !customBar.children?.length) customBar.remove();
        } catch (_) {}
    }

    function unmountMenuEntry() {
        drainStops(runtime.menuStops);
        try { hostDocument()?.getElementById?.(EXT_MENU_ITEM_ID)?.remove?.(); } catch (_) {}
    }

    function syncQrAndMenuIndicators() {
        const doc = hostDocument();
        if (!doc) return;
        const active = runtime.settings.pluginEnabled !== false;
        const pluginOnly = active && isPluginOnlyBypassStoryMode();
        const qrBtn = doc.getElementById(QR_DOM_BTN_ID);
        if (qrBtn) {
            qrBtn.textContent = !active ? ('💰 省流 ' + VERSION) : (pluginOnly ? ('🧩 双马尾 ' + VERSION) : ('🛡 双马尾 ' + VERSION));
            qrBtn.title = active
                ? '双马尾插件：已开启（左键打开控制台 / 右键一键切换省流直连）'
                : '双马尾插件：省流直连模式（左键打开控制台 / 右键一键开启）';
            qrBtn.style.borderColor = active ? 'rgba(52,211,153,.55)' : 'rgba(251,191,36,.65)';
            qrBtn.style.color = active ? '#6ee7b7' : '#fcd34d';
        }
    }

    // 直接向电脑端/移动端酒馆输入栏上方 QR 快捷栏（#qr--bar）或魔法棒扩展菜单（#extensionsMenu）注入原生入口按钮：
    // 即使玩家没开 QuickReply 扩展、或者在酒馆助手里关掉了“脚本按钮”，电脑端输入框上方依然 100% 看得到 QR 按钮！
    function mountDirectQrAndMenuButtons() {
        const doc = hostDocument();
        if (!doc?.body) return false;
        let mountedAny = false;

        // (A) 输入框上方 QR 栏直挂按钮（优先挂进 #qr--bar > .qr--buttons，若用户未启用 QR 扩展则挂在 #send_form 顶部工具条）
        if (runtime.settings.entryQrEnabled === false) {
            unmountQrButton();
        } else {
            let existingQrBtn = doc.getElementById(QR_DOM_BTN_ID);
            if (!existingQrBtn || !existingQrBtn.isConnected) {
                unmountQrButton();
                let qrContainer = doc.querySelector('#qr--bar .qr--buttons') || doc.getElementById('qr--bar');
                if (!qrContainer) {
                    const sendForm = doc.getElementById('send_form') || doc.getElementById('form_sheld');
                    if (sendForm) {
                        let customBar = doc.getElementById('ufi-custom-qr-strip');
                        if (!customBar) {
                            customBar = doc.createElement('div');
                            customBar.id = 'ufi-custom-qr-strip';
                            customBar.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:3px 6px;flex-wrap:wrap;';
                            sendForm.insertBefore(customBar, sendForm.firstChild);
                        }
                        qrContainer = customBar;
                    }
                }
                if (qrContainer) {
                    const qrBtn = doc.createElement('div');
                    qrBtn.id = QR_DOM_BTN_ID;
                    qrBtn.className = 'qr--button menu_button interactable';
                    qrBtn.tabIndex = 0;
                    qrBtn.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                    qrBtn.style.cssText = 'display:inline-flex !important;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 9px;margin:2px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,.55);background:rgba(15,23,42,.65);color:#6ee7b7;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.3;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;white-space:nowrap;flex:0 0 auto;';
                    const onQrClick = ev => {
                        ev.preventDefault?.();
                        ev.stopPropagation?.();
                        openConfigPanel();
                    };
                    const onQrContext = ev => {
                        ev.preventDefault?.();
                        ev.stopPropagation?.();
                        setPluginEnabled(!(runtime.settings.pluginEnabled !== false));
                    };
                    qrBtn.addEventListener('click', onQrClick);
                    qrBtn.addEventListener('contextmenu', onQrContext);
                    qrContainer.appendChild(qrBtn);
                    runtime.qrStops.push(() => {
                        qrBtn.removeEventListener('click', onQrClick);
                        qrBtn.removeEventListener('contextmenu', onQrContext);
                        qrBtn.remove();
                        const customBar = doc.getElementById('ufi-custom-qr-strip');
                        if (customBar && !customBar.children?.length) customBar.remove();
                    });
                    mountedAny = true;
                }
            } else {
                mountedAny = true;
            }
        }

        // (B) 左下角魔法棒扩展菜单（#extensionsMenu）兜底入口，防悬浮球被任何主题遮挡
        if (runtime.settings.entryMenuEnabled === false) {
            unmountMenuEntry();
        } else {
            const extMenu = doc.getElementById('extensionsMenu');
            const existingMenuItem = doc.getElementById(EXT_MENU_ITEM_ID);
            if (extMenu && (!existingMenuItem || !existingMenuItem.isConnected)) {
                unmountMenuEntry();
                const item = doc.createElement('div');
                item.id = EXT_MENU_ITEM_ID;
                item.className = 'list-group-item flex-container flexGap5 interactable';
                item.tabIndex = 0;
                item.innerHTML = '<span style="font-weight:700">🛡</span><span>双马尾插件控制台</span>';
                const onMenuClick = () => openConfigPanel();
                item.addEventListener('click', onMenuClick);
                extMenu.appendChild(item);
                runtime.menuStops.push(() => {
                    item.removeEventListener('click', onMenuClick);
                    item.remove();
                });
                mountedAny = true;
            } else if (existingMenuItem?.isConnected) {
                mountedAny = true;
            }
        }

        syncQrAndMenuIndicators();
        return mountedAny;
    }

    function syncLauncherEntries(options = {}) {
        if (runtime.settings.entryFloatingEnabled !== false) {
            if (!runtime.launcher || !runtime.launcher.isConnected) {
                mountFallbackLauncher();
            } else {
                syncLauncherAppearance();
            }
        } else {
            unmountFallbackLauncher();
        }

        if (runtime.settings.entryQrEnabled === false) {
            syncTavernScriptButtonVisibility(false);
        } else if (options.syncTavernButton === true) {
            syncTavernScriptButtonVisibility(true);
        }

        mountDirectQrAndMenuButtons();
        syncLauncherAppearance();
        try { updateFabStatus(); } catch (_) {}
    }

    function ensureDesktopFloatingVisible() {
        if (!runtime.disposed && interceptionEnabled()) {
            try { installFetch(); } catch (_) {}
        }
        const doc = hostDocument();
        if (runtime.settings.entryFloatingEnabled !== false) {
            const existing = doc?.getElementById?.(FALLBACK_LAUNCHER_ID);
            if (!existing || !existing.isConnected) {
                mountFallbackLauncher();
            } else {
                // 每次巡检把球夹回视口内：转屏、手机键盘弹出、窗口缩放后都不会跑到屏幕外
                const vw = Number(doc?.defaultView?.innerWidth || 0);
                const vh = Number(doc?.defaultView?.innerHeight || 0);
                if (vw > 160 && vh > 160 && !existing.classList.contains('ufi-dragging')) {
                    const x = parseFloat(existing.style.left);
                    const y = parseFloat(existing.style.top);
                    const rect = existing.getBoundingClientRect();
                    const outside = !Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(y)
                        || rect.right <= 8 || rect.left >= vw - 8 || rect.bottom <= 8 || rect.top >= vh - 8;
                    if (outside) {
                        const fix = defaultFabPos(doc);
                        placeFab(existing, fix);
                        saveFabPos(fix.x, fix.y);
                    } else {
                        const clamped = clampFabPos(doc, x, y);
                        if (clamped.x !== Math.round(x) || clamped.y !== Math.round(y)) {
                            placeFab(existing, clamped);
                            saveFabPos(clamped.x, clamped.y);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            unmountFallbackLauncher();
        }
        mountDirectQrAndMenuButtons();
    }

    function registerLauncher() {
        let hasToolbar = false;
        try {
            const api = toolbarApi();
            if (api) {
                if (typeof api.getButtons === 'function' && typeof api.replaceButtons === 'function') {
                    const migrated = migrateLegacyScriptButtons(api.getButtons());
                    if (migrated.changed) {
                        try { api.replaceButtons(migrated.buttons); } catch (_) {}
                    }
                }
                if (runtime.settings.entryQrEnabled !== false) {
                    try { api.appendButtons?.([{ name: LAUNCHER_BUTTON_NAME, visible: true }]); } catch (_) {}
                    hasToolbar = true;
                } else {
                    syncTavernScriptButtonVisibility(false);
                }
                const result = api.eventOn(api.getButtonEvent(LAUNCHER_BUTTON_NAME), openConfigPanel);
                if (typeof result === 'function') runtime.uiStops.push(result);
                else if (result && typeof result.stop === 'function') runtime.uiStops.push(() => result.stop());
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn(`[${SCRIPT_NAME}] 酒馆助手脚本按钮注册提示`, error);
        }
        const hasFloating = mountFallbackLauncher();
        const hasDirectQr = mountDirectQrAndMenuButtons();

        // 电脑端启动自愈：酒馆主界面/QR栏可能晚于脚本 0.5~3 秒完成 DOM 渲染或因切换聊天重绘，定时巡检自动补挂
        const healDelays = [400, 1200, 2800];
        for (const ms of healDelays) {
            const tid = setTimeout(() => { if (!runtime.disposed) ensureDesktopFloatingVisible(); }, ms);
            runtime.uiStops.push(() => clearTimeout(tid));
        }
        const keepAliveTimer = setInterval(() => {
            if (!runtime.disposed) ensureDesktopFloatingVisible();
        }, 4000);
        runtime.uiStops.push(() => clearInterval(keepAliveTimer));

        const doc = hostDocument();
        const hasQrDom = Boolean(doc?.getElementById?.(QR_DOM_BTN_ID));
        const hasMenuDom = Boolean(doc?.getElementById?.(EXT_MENU_ITEM_ID));
        return [hasToolbar && 'th-qr', hasQrDom && 'dom-qr', hasMenuDom && 'menu', hasFloating && 'floating'].filter(Boolean).join('+') || (hasDirectQr ? 'direct' : 'none');
    }

    function parseSemver(ver) {
        const match = String(ver || '').trim().match(/^v?(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)(?:[-+].*)?$/i);
        if (!match) return null;
        return [Number(match[1]), Number(match[2]), Number(match[3])];
    }

    function compareSemver(a, b) {
        const pa = parseSemver(a);
        const pb = parseSemver(b);
        if (!pa || !pb) return 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
            if (pa[i] > pb[i]) return 1;
            if (pa[i] < pb[i]) return -1;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    function decodeBase64Utf8(b64) {
        const clean = String(b64 || '').replace(/\s+/g, '');
        if (!clean || typeof atob !== 'function') return '';
        const bin = atob(clean);
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i += 1) {
            bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
        }
        if (typeof TextDecoder === 'function') {
            return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes);
        }
        let escaped = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 1) {
            escaped += '%' + bytes[i].toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
        }
        return decodeURIComponent(escaped);
    }

    function getCleanFetch() {
        for (const host of hostWindows()) {
            try {
                let fn = host?.fetch;
                let guard = 0;
                while (fn?.[FETCH_MARKER]?.original && guard++ < 8) {
                    fn = fn[FETCH_MARKER].original;
                }
                if (typeof fn === 'function') return { fn, host };
            } catch (_) {}
        }
        return null;
    }

    function buildMirrorUrls(relPath, { manual = false } = {}) {
        const { owner, repo, branch, checkIntervalMs } = GITHUB_UPDATE_CONFIG;
        const encodedPath = String(relPath || '')
            .split('/')
            .filter(Boolean)
            .map(seg => encodeURIComponent(seg))
            .join('/');
        const stamp = manual ? Date.now() : Math.floor(Date.now() / checkIntervalMs);
        return [
            {
                source: 'GitHub API',
                url: 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + owner + '/' + repo + '/contents/' + encodedPath + '?ref=' + encodeURIComponent(branch),
                isGithubApi: true,
            },
            {
                source: 'GitHub Raw',
                url: 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/' + owner + '/' + repo + '/' + encodeURIComponent(branch) + '/' + encodedPath + '?t=' + stamp,
                isGithubApi: false,
            },
            {
                source: 'jsDelivr CDN',
                url: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/' + owner + '/' + repo + '@' + encodeURIComponent(branch) + '/' + encodedPath,
                isGithubApi: false,
            },
            {
                source: 'TestingCF jsDelivr',
                url: 'https://testingcf.jsdelivr.net/gh/' + owner + '/' + repo + '@' + encodeURIComponent(branch) + '/' + encodedPath,
                isGithubApi: false,
            },
            {
                source: 'Fastly jsDelivr',
                url: 'https://fastly.jsdelivr.net/gh/' + owner + '/' + repo + '@' + encodeURIComponent(branch) + '/' + encodedPath,
                isGithubApi: false,
            },
        ];
    }

    async function fetchJsonWithTimeout(target, { manual = false } = {}) {
        const clean = getCleanFetch();
        if (!clean) throw new Error('当前环境缺少 fetch 接口');
        const controller = typeof AbortController === 'function' ? new AbortController() : null;
        let timer = null;
        try {
            if (controller) {
                timer = setTimeout(() => {
                    try { controller.abort(new Error('timeout')); } catch (_) {}
                }, GITHUB_UPDATE_CONFIG.requestTimeoutMs);
            }
            const init = {
                method: 'GET',
                cache: manual ? 'no-store' : 'default',
                ...(controller ? { signal: controller.signal } : {}),
            };
            const response = await clean.fn.call(clean.host, target.url, init);
            if (!response || !response.ok) {
                throw new Error('HTTP ' + (response?.status || 'ERR'));
            }
            const rawText = await response.text();
            let parsed = JSON.parse(rawText);
            if (
                target.isGithubApi
                && parsed
                && typeof parsed === 'object'
                && parsed.encoding === 'base64'
                && typeof parsed.content === 'string'
                && typeof parsed.version !== 'string'
                && parsed.type !== 'script'
            ) {
                const decoded = decodeBase64Utf8(parsed.content);
                parsed = JSON.parse(decoded);
            }
            return parsed;
        } finally {
            if (timer != null) clearTimeout(timer);
        }
    }

    async function fetchJsonFromMirrors(relPath, { manual = false } = {}) {
        const mirrors = buildMirrorUrls(relPath, { manual });
        const errors = [];
        for (const target of mirrors) {
            if (runtime.disposed) throw new Error('脚本已卸载');
            try {
                const data = await fetchJsonWithTimeout(target, { manual });
                return { data, source: target.source, url: target.url };
            } catch (error) {
                errors.push(target.source + ': ' + (error?.message || String(error)));
            }
        }
        throw new Error('所有更新源不可达（' + errors.slice(0, 2).join('；') + '）');
    }

    function readUpdateCheckStamp() {
        try {
            const raw = settingsStorage()?.getItem(GITHUB_UPDATE_CONFIG.lastCheckStorageKey);
            if (!raw) return null;
            const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
            return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : null;
        } catch (_) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    function writeUpdateCheckStamp(payload) {
        try {
            settingsStorage()?.setItem(GITHUB_UPDATE_CONFIG.lastCheckStorageKey, JSON.stringify({
                checkedAt: Date.now(),
                ...payload,
            }));
        } catch (_) {}
    }

    function isAutoUpdateThrottled() {
        const stamp = readUpdateCheckStamp();
        const checkedAt = Number(stamp?.checkedAt || 0);
        return checkedAt > 0 && (Date.now() - checkedAt) < GITHUB_UPDATE_CONFIG.checkIntervalMs;
    }

    function validateRemoteScriptPayload(scriptObj, expectedVersion) {
        if (!scriptObj || typeof scriptObj !== 'object' || Array.isArray(scriptObj)) {
            throw new Error('远程脚本格式无效（非 JSON 对象）');
        }
        if (scriptObj.type !== 'script') {
            throw new Error('远程脚本 type 字段异常');
        }
        if (scriptObj.id !== GITHUB_UPDATE_CONFIG.scriptId) {
            throw new Error('远程脚本 ID 不匹配');
        }
        if (typeof scriptObj.content !== 'string' || scriptObj.content.length < 2000 || !scriptObj.content.includes(API_NAME)) {
            throw new Error('远程脚本正文不完整或已损坏');
        }
        const verMatch = scriptObj.content.match(/ const\s+VERSION\s*=\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/);
        if (!verMatch || compareSemver(verMatch[1], expectedVersion) !== 0) {
            throw new Error('远程脚本源码版本号与 manifest.json 不一致');
        }
        return true;
    }

    function resolveTavernHelperFn(methodName) {
        for (const host of hostWindows()) {
            try {
                if (typeof host?.[methodName] === 'function') return host[methodName].bind(host);
                if (typeof host?.TavernHelper?.[methodName] === 'function') {
                    return host.TavernHelper[methodName].bind(host.TavernHelper);
                }
            } catch (_) {}
        }
        return null;
    }

    function resolveOwnScriptId() {
        try {
            if (typeof getScriptId === 'function') {
                const id = getScriptId();
                if (typeof id === 'string' && id.trim()) return id.trim();
            }
        } catch (_) {}
        try {
            const fn = resolveTavernHelperFn('getScriptId');
            if (fn) {
                const id = fn();
                if (typeof id === 'string' && id.trim()) return id.trim();
            }
        } catch (_) {}
        return '';
    }

    function isTreeScriptNode(node) {
        return Boolean(
            node
            && typeof node === 'object'
            && !Array.isArray(node.scripts)
            && !Array.isArray(node.children)
            && node.type !== 'folder'
            && (node.type === 'script' || typeof node.content === 'string')
        );
    }

    function isTreeFolderNode(node) {
        return Boolean(
            node
            && typeof node === 'object'
            && (node.type === 'folder' || Array.isArray(node.scripts) || Array.isArray(node.children))
        );
    }

    function isMatchingGuardSignature(node, requireEnabled = true) {
        if (!isTreeScriptNode(node)) return false;
        if (requireEnabled && node.enabled === false) return false;
        const c = typeof node.content === 'string' ? node.content : '';
        return c.includes(API_NAME) && (c.includes(SETTINGS_KEY) || c.includes(GITHUB_UPDATE_CONFIG.repo));
    }

    function treeHasMatchingNode(nodes, predicate) {
        if (!Array.isArray(nodes)) return false;
        for (const node of nodes) {
            if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') continue;
            if (isTreeScriptNode(node) && predicate(node)) return true;
            if (isTreeFolderNode(node)) {
                const children = Array.isArray(node.scripts) ? node.scripts : node.children;
                if (treeHasMatchingNode(children, predicate)) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    function patchScriptTreeArray(nodes, remoteScript, predicate) {
        if (!Array.isArray(nodes)) return [false, nodes];
        let matchedAny = false;
        const nextNodes = nodes.map(node => {
            if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return node;
            if (isTreeScriptNode(node) && predicate(node)) {
                matchedAny = true;
                return {
                    ...node,
                    name: typeof remoteScript.name === 'string' && remoteScript.name ? remoteScript.name : node.name,
                    content: remoteScript.content,
                    info: typeof remoteScript.info === 'string' ? remoteScript.info : node.info,
                    ...(remoteScript.button && typeof remoteScript.button === 'object' ? { button: clone(remoteScript.button) } : {}),
                    ...(remoteScript.data && typeof remoteScript.data === 'object' && node.data == null ? { data: clone(remoteScript.data) } : {}),
                    id: node.id,
                    type: 'script',
                    enabled: node.enabled,
                };
            }
            if (isTreeFolderNode(node)) {
                const key = Array.isArray(node.scripts) ? 'scripts' : 'children';
                const [childMatched, nextChildren] = patchScriptTreeArray(node[key], remoteScript, predicate);
                if (childMatched) {
                    matchedAny = true;
                    return { ...node, [key]: nextChildren };
                }
            }
            return node;
        });
        return [matchedAny, matchedAny ? nextNodes : nodes];
    }

    async function applyRemoteScriptToTavernTrees(remoteScript) {
        const updateTreesWith = resolveTavernHelperFn('updateScriptTreesWith');
        const getTrees = resolveTavernHelperFn('getScriptTrees');
        const replaceTrees = resolveTavernHelperFn('replaceScriptTrees');
        if (!updateTreesWith && !(getTrees && replaceTrees)) {
            return { apiAvailable: false, updatedScopes: [], inspectedScopes: [], liveId: '' };
        }
        const scopes = ['global', 'preset', 'character'];
        const liveId = resolveOwnScriptId();
        const configId = GITHUB_UPDATE_CONFIG.scriptId;
        const matchers = [];
        if (liveId) {
            matchers.push({ kind: 'liveId', fn: node => node.id === liveId });
        }
        if (configId && configId !== liveId) {
            matchers.push({ kind: 'configId', fn: node => node.id === configId });
        }
        matchers.push({ kind: 'signature-enabled', fn: node => isMatchingGuardSignature(node, true) });
        matchers.push({ kind: 'signature-any', fn: node => isMatchingGuardSignature(node, false) });

        const updatedScopes = [];
        const inspectedScopes = [];
        let chosenBy = '';

        // 优先使用无副作用只读扫描 getScriptTrees，精确锁定作用域后再写入，避免改写/重载无关作用域
        if (getTrees && (updateTreesWith || replaceTrees)) {
            const readableScopes = [];
            for (const scope of scopes) {
                if (runtime.disposed) break;
                try {
                    const trees = await getTrees({ type: scope });
                    if (Array.isArray(trees)) {
                        inspectedScopes.push(scope);
                        readableScopes.push({ scope, trees });
                    }
                } catch (_) {
                    // 部分作用域（如当前未绑定预设/角色卡时）可能抛出异常，跳过即可
                }
            }
            let selectedMatcher = null;
            let targetScopes = [];
            for (const m of matchers) {
                const hits = readableScopes.filter(entry => treeHasMatchingNode(entry.trees, m.fn));
                if (hits.length) {
                    selectedMatcher = m;
                    targetScopes = hits.map(entry => entry.scope);
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (selectedMatcher) {
                chosenBy = selectedMatcher.kind;
                for (const scope of targetScopes) {
                    if (runtime.disposed) break;
                    try {
                        if (updateTreesWith) {
                            let wrote = false;
                            await updateTreesWith(trees => {
                                const [matched, nextTrees] = patchScriptTreeArray(trees, remoteScript, selectedMatcher.fn);
                                if (matched) wrote = true;
                                return nextTrees;
                            }, { type: scope });
                            if (wrote) updatedScopes.push(scope);
                        } else {
                            const found = readableScopes.find(e => e.scope === scope);
                            const [matched, nextTrees] = patchScriptTreeArray(found?.trees, remoteScript, selectedMatcher.fn);
                            if (matched) {
                                await replaceTrees(nextTrees, { type: scope });
                                updatedScopes.push(scope);
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (_) {}
                }
            }
            return { apiAvailable: true, updatedScopes, inspectedScopes, liveId, chosenBy };
        }

        // 兜底：若仅暴露 updateScriptTreesWith 而无 getScriptTrees，则在回调内依次按 liveId / configId / signature 匹配
        for (const scope of scopes) {
            if (runtime.disposed) break;
            try {
                let matchedInScope = false;
                await updateTreesWith(trees => {
                    inspectedScopes.push(scope);
                    for (const m of matchers) {
                        const [matched, nextTrees] = patchScriptTreeArray(trees, remoteScript, m.fn);
                        if (matched) {
                            matchedInScope = true;
                            chosenBy = chosenBy || m.kind;
                            return nextTrees;
                        }
                    }
                    return trees;
                }, { type: scope });
                if (matchedInScope) updatedScopes.push(scope);
            } catch (_) {}
        }
        return { apiAvailable: true, updatedScopes, inspectedScopes, liveId, chosenBy };
    }

    function setUpdateState(patch) {
        runtime.updateState = {
            ...runtime.updateState,
            ...patch,
        };
        syncConfigPanel();
    }

    function setAutoUpdateEnabled(enabled) {
        runtime.settings.autoUpdateEnabled = Boolean(enabled);
        saveSettings();
        syncConfigPanel();
        notify('success', runtime.settings.autoUpdateEnabled ? '云端自动更新已开启' : '云端自动更新已关闭（仍可随时手动检查）');
        return runtime.settings.autoUpdateEnabled;
    }

    async function checkForUpdate(options = {}) {
        const manual = options?.manual === true;
        if (runtime.disposed) return { ok: false, skipped: true, reason: 'disposed' };
        if (!manual && runtime.settings.autoUpdateEnabled === false) {
            return { ok: false, skipped: true, reason: 'disabled' };
        }
        if (!manual && isAutoUpdateThrottled()) {
            const stamp = readUpdateCheckStamp();
            if (stamp?.latestVersion && compareSemver(stamp.latestVersion, VERSION) <= 0) {
                setUpdateState({
                    status: 'up-to-date',
                    latestVersion: stamp.latestVersion,
                    checkedAt: Number(stamp.checkedAt || 0),
                    source: stamp.source || '',
                    message: '当前 v' + VERSION + ' 已是最新（1 小时内已检查）',
                });
            }
            return { ok: false, skipped: true, reason: 'throttled' };
        }
        if (runtime.updatePromise) return runtime.updatePromise;

        const task = (async () => {
            setUpdateState({
                status: 'checking',
                message: '正在通过 GitHub / CDN 镜像检查新版本...',
            });
            try {
                const manifestRes = await fetchJsonFromMirrors(GITHUB_UPDATE_CONFIG.manifestPath, { manual });
                if (runtime.disposed) return { ok: false, skipped: true, reason: 'disposed' };
                const manifest = manifestRes.data;
                const remoteVersion = String(manifest?.version || '').trim();
                if (!parseSemver(remoteVersion)) {
                    throw new Error('manifest.json 缺少合法版本号');
                }
                const cmp = compareSemver(remoteVersion, VERSION);
                writeUpdateCheckStamp({
                    latestVersion: remoteVersion,
                    source: manifestRes.source,
                    status: cmp > 0 ? 'found-newer' : 'up-to-date',
                });

                if (cmp <= 0) {
                    setUpdateState({
                        status: 'up-to-date',
                        latestVersion: remoteVersion,
                        checkedAt: Date.now(),
                        source: manifestRes.source,
                        notes: String(manifest?.notes || ''),
                        needsReload: false,
                        message: '当前 v' + VERSION + ' 已是最新版本（检查源：' + manifestRes.source + '）',
                    });
                    if (manual) notify('info', '当前 v' + VERSION + ' 已是最新版本');
                    return { ok: true, updated: false, currentVersion: VERSION, latestVersion: remoteVersion, source: manifestRes.source };
                }

                const rawFile = typeof manifest?.file === 'string' ? manifest.file.trim() : '';
                const scriptRelPath = /^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+(?:/[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+)*\.json$/.test(rawFile)
                    ? rawFile
                    : GITHUB_UPDATE_CONFIG.scriptPath;
                const scriptRes = await fetchJsonFromMirrors(scriptRelPath, { manual });
                if (runtime.disposed) return { ok: false, skipped: true, reason: 'disposed' };
                const remoteScript = scriptRes.data;
                validateRemoteScriptPayload(remoteScript, remoteVersion);

                const applyRes = await applyRemoteScriptToTavernTrees(remoteScript);
                if (runtime.disposed) return { ok: false, skipped: true, reason: 'disposed' };

                if (!applyRes.apiAvailable) {
                    const msg = '发现新版本 v' + remoteVersion + '，但当前酒馆助手版本不支持脚本树自更新，请从 GitHub 手动下载导入';
                    setUpdateState({
                        status: 'manual-required',
                        latestVersion: remoteVersion,
                        checkedAt: Date.now(),
                        source: scriptRes.source,
                        notes: String(manifest?.notes || ''),
                        needsReload: false,
                        message: msg,
                    });
                    notify('warning', msg);
                    return { ok: true, updated: false, manualRequired: true, latestVersion: remoteVersion };
                }

                if (!applyRes.updatedScopes.length) {
                    const msg = '发现新版本 v' + remoteVersion + '，但未在全局/预设/角色脚本树中找到匹配脚本 ID（可直接从 GitHub 覆盖导入）';
                    setUpdateState({
                        status: 'not-installed',
                        latestVersion: remoteVersion,
                        checkedAt: Date.now(),
                        source: scriptRes.source,
                        notes: String(manifest?.notes || ''),
                        needsReload: false,
                        message: msg,
                    });
                    if (manual) notify('warning', msg);
                    return { ok: true, updated: false, notFoundInTree: true, latestVersion: remoteVersion };
                }

                const notesSuffix = manifest?.notes ? ' · ' + String(manifest.notes) : '';
                const msg = '已静默更新至 v' + remoteVersion + '（写入：' + applyRes.updatedScopes.join(', ') + '），刷新页面即可生效' + notesSuffix;
                setUpdateState({
                    status: 'updated',
                    latestVersion: remoteVersion,
                    checkedAt: Date.now(),
                    source: scriptRes.source,
                    notes: String(manifest?.notes || ''),
                    updatedScopes: applyRes.updatedScopes,
                    needsReload: true,
                    message: msg,
                });
                notify('success', '已后台更新至 v' + remoteVersion + '，刷新页面后生效');
                return {
                    ok: true,
                    updated: true,
                    currentVersion: VERSION,
                    latestVersion: remoteVersion,
                    updatedScopes: applyRes.updatedScopes,
                    source: scriptRes.source,
                };
            } catch (error) {
                const errMsg = error?.message || String(error);
                writeUpdateCheckStamp({
                    latestVersion: runtime.updateState?.latestVersion || VERSION,
                    status: 'error',
                });
                const msg = (manual ? '检查更新失败：' : '云端检查暂未连上（离线不影响本脚本正常拦截）：') + errMsg;
                setUpdateState({
                    status: 'error',
                    checkedAt: Date.now(),
                    needsReload: false,
                    message: msg,
                });
                if (manual) notify('warning', msg);
                return { ok: false, error: errMsg };
            } finally {
                runtime.updatePromise = null;
            }
        })();

        runtime.updatePromise = task;
        return task;
    }

    function status() {
        return {
            version: VERSION,
            capabilities: Array.from(runtime.capabilities.values()).map(value => ({ ...value })),
            activeRequests: runtime.activeRuns.size,
            instanceId: INSTANCE_ID,
            installed: runtime.installed,
            settings: { ...runtime.settings },
            updateState: { ...runtime.updateState },
            lastRun: runtime.lastRun ? { ...runtime.lastRun } : null,
            runHistory: runtime.runHistory.map(item => ({ ...item })),
        };
    }

    function exposeApi() {
        const host = rootWindow();
        const api = {
            instanceId: INSTANCE_ID,
            openPanel: openConfigPanel,
            closePanel: closeConfigPanel,
            getStatus: status,
            setPluginEnabled,
            setToolTransport,
            setHydrogenThinkingLevel(level) { if (['auto', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh'].includes(level)) { runtime.settings.hydrogenThinkingLevel = level; runtime.settings.effortMode = resolveArgonEffortMode(); saveSettings(); syncConfigPanel(); } return runtime.settings.hydrogenThinkingLevel; },
            setExternalPlugin(enabled, mode, pluginOnly) { runtime.settings.externalPluginEnabled = Boolean(enabled); if (['route_only', 'full_inject'].includes(mode)) runtime.settings.externalPluginMode = mode; if (typeof pluginOnly === 'boolean') runtime.settings.externalPluginOnly = pluginOnly; saveSettings(); syncConfigPanel(); return { enabled: runtime.settings.externalPluginEnabled, mode: runtime.settings.externalPluginMode, pluginOnly: runtime.settings.externalPluginOnly }; },
            setAutoBypassVertex(enabled) { runtime.settings.autoBypassVertex = Boolean(enabled); saveSettings(); syncConfigPanel(); return runtime.settings.autoBypassVertex; },
            setSystemDemote(enabled) { runtime.settings.systemDemoteEnabled = Boolean(enabled); saveSettings(); syncConfigPanel(); return runtime.settings.systemDemoteEnabled; },
            setInputMode,
            setTextLibraryPromptEnabled,
            setTextLibraryUserInputEnabled,
            setSystemPromptSlot,
            setUserInputSlot,
            saveSystemPromptText,
            saveUserInputText,
            saveSystemPromptSlot,
            saveUserInputSlot,
            applyTextLibraryMarkers,
            compactEncode,
            prepareRequest,
            extractContent,
            checkForUpdate,
            setAutoUpdateEnabled,
            setUiEntries,
            getUiEntries: getUiEntriesState,
            dispose,
        };
        host[API_NAME] = api;
        host[LOADED_FLAG] = true;
        host[STATE_NAME] = { instanceId: INSTANCE_ID, startedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    }

    function dispose(reason = 'manual') {
        if (runtime.disposed) return;
        runtime.disposed = true;
        for (const run of runtime.activeRuns.values()) run.abort('script-disposed');
        runtime.activeRuns.clear();
        removeFetch();
        clearPanelStops();
        runtime.lastFocusedElement = null;
        unmountFallbackLauncher();
        unmountQrButton();
        unmountMenuEntry();
        drainStops(runtime.uiStops);
        runtime.panel?.remove();
        runtime.style?.remove();
        runtime.launcher?.remove();
        const host = rootWindow();
        if (host[API_NAME]?.instanceId === INSTANCE_ID) {
            try { delete host[API_NAME]; } catch (_) { host[API_NAME] = undefined; }
        }
        if (host[STATE_NAME]?.instanceId === INSTANCE_ID) {
            try { delete host[STATE_NAME]; } catch (_) { host[STATE_NAME] = undefined; }
        }
        host[LOADED_FLAG] = false;
        console.log(`[${SCRIPT_NAME}] 已卸载：${reason}`);
    }


    function cleanupLegacyAntiRouteResiduals() {
        try {
            const th = typeof TavernHelper !== 'undefined' ? TavernHelper : window.TavernHelper || parentWin.TavernHelper || {};
            const uninj = typeof uninjectPrompts === 'function' ? uninjectPrompts : th.uninjectPrompts;
            if (typeof uninj === 'function') {
                uninj(['g4a_top_prefix_bust', 'g4a_bottom_gate_lock', 'g4a_anti_route_header', 'g4a_anti_route_footer']);
            }
        } catch (_) {}
        try {
            const stContext = parentWin.SillyTavern?.getContext?.();
            const eventSource = stContext?.eventSource;
